rationale: The spread of 173 bps alone makes this trade structurally difficult — entering at ask ($386.21) with a bid of $379.58 means immediate slippage that consumes most of a reasonable intraday move. Price is mid-range (46% of today's range), sitting between VWAP ($379.07) and the 9-EMA ($389.61) with no clear directional conviction from the last five candles (volatile, choppy action with large wicks). Despite the positive earnings beat, the stock gapped down sharply and is trading well below prior close, suggesting the news is already absorbed and the broad risk-off environment (SPY -0.75%, VIXY +3.67%) is dominating; the risk/reward on either side is unclear given the illiquidity and noise.
